lines.beaver_en: How is people's spending these days? I'm curious.
lines.learner: 요즘은 근검절약을 소비 특징으로 꼽을 수 있어요.
lines.en: These days, thrift stands out as the key spending trait.
lines.roman: yojeumeun geungeomjeoryageul sobi teukjingeuro kkobeul su isseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Really? Aren't there many people living in luxury?
lines.learner: 거액을 쓰는 사치는 부유한 사람들 이야기예요.
lines.en: Spending huge sums on luxury is for wealthy people.
lines.roman: geogaegeul sseuneun sachineun buyuhan saramdeul iyagiyeyo.

lines.en: They check their balance daily and cut phone bills first.

lines.beaver_en: How about saving up a lump sum?
lines.en: People pick installment savings as the top way.
lines.roman: jeokgeumeul mokdon mallyeon bangbeop irwiro kkopdeoragoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Have fewer people been buying lottery tickets?
lines.learner: 아니요, 잔돈으로 복권을 사는 사람은 늘었대요.
lines.en: No, more people buy lottery tickets with small change.
lines.roman: aniyo, jandoneuro bokgwoneul saneun sarameun neureotdaeyo.

lines.learner: 큰돈 없이도 부자를 꿈꿀 수 있으니까요.
lines.en: Because you can dream of being rich without big money.
lines.roman: keundon eopsido bujareul kkumkkul su isseunikkayo.

lines.beaver: 돈 관리와 금융에 대해 더 말씀해 주시겠습니까?
lines.beaver_en: Could you tell me more about money management?
lines.beaver_roman: don gwalliwa geumyunge daehae deo malsseumhae jusigetseumnikka?
lines.learner: 출금 알림을 켜서 돈 낭비를 막는 사람이 많아요.
lines.en: Many turn on withdrawal alerts to stop wasting money.
lines.roman: chulgeum allimeul kyeoseo don nangbireul mangneun sarami manayo.

lines.beaver_en: They must check card bills carefully too.
lines.learner: 네, 청구 내역 확인을 습관처럼 한대요.
lines.en: Yes, they say checking bills has become a habit.
lines.roman: ne, cheonggu naeyeok hwagineul seupgwancheoreom handaeyo.

lines.learner: 네, 카드를 쓴다면 꼭 필요한 습관이죠.
lines.en: Yes, it's a must-have habit if you use cards.
lines.roman: ne, kadeureul sseundamyeon kkok piryohan seupgwanijyo.

lines.beaver: 좋은 말씀 감사합니다. 저도 적금부터 들게요.
lines.beaver_en: Thanks for the advice. I'll start a savings plan too.
lines.beaver_roman: joeun malsseum gamsahamnida. jeodo jeokgeumbuteo deulgeyo.
lines.learner: 네, 저도 오늘 하나 들 거예요. 또 뵐게요.
lines.en: Sure, I'll open one today too. See you again.
lines.roman: ne, jeodo oneul hana deul geoyeyo. tto boelgeyo.
